narrative.summary: Mercer County, WV has 8 flagged needs. The most severe are carbon-intensive electricity, few or no public EV chargers and low household income. 5 opportunities were matched to these needs. The highest-ranked is "Community solar on Beeson Highwall".

caveats: Figures marked as estimates are rough. The assumptions behind each one are listed with it.
A listed funding program is a lead to check, not a finding that the county or project is eligible. Confirm status and deadlines with the agency.
EPA's landfill database does not include every landfill.
Electricity bill and grid carbon figures are state averages, not county figures.
Some data could not be loaded (OpenStreetMap public buildings), so needs or sites may be missing from this report.
